KICK at 3,112 m MD (KOPILI) | Severity: CRITICAL | NPT: 46.0 hrs | MW: 12.1 ppg
Well kicked at 3,112 m MD on entering Kopili shale; pit gain 18 bbl, SIDPP 620 psi, SICP 780 psi. Gas
units peaked at 1,450. Influx circulated out via driller's method.
Mitigation: Shut in well on annular preventer, circulated kick out via driller's method and raised
MW from 12.1 to 13.0 ppg.
Lesson: Raise MW before the Kopili transition; overpressure onset is sharp in this field.
